turns.text: hey, can you help me write a friendly script declining a visit? some of my wife's coworkers want to stop by this weekend to meet our baby. i want to say no without sounding like a jerk. thanks!
Happy to help. A few quick questions so it fits: is this going out as a text, an email, or something you'd say out loud? And do you want to leave the door open for a visit another time?

text probably, to be sent from my phone. and yes, definitely want to leave the door open, maybe later in the fall. weekends are tough right now, evenings especially. theo (the baby) has this crying stretch from like 5-8 pm that basically eats the whole evening, so visitors wouldn't get much out of it anyway lol. also hana has a lot going on right now so i'd like the message to say that. but it should just come from me, no need to loop her in on it 🙂

Got it. Here's a friendly version you can send as a text:

"Hi [name]! Thank you so much for wanting to stop by and meet Theo, that means a lot to us. This weekend isn't going to work, though. Hana has a lot going on right now, and our evenings are pretty rough with Theo's fussy stretch, so he wouldn't be at his best for company. We'd love to have you over later in the fall once things settle down. I'll reach out with a few dates. Thanks for understanding!"

A shorter option:

"Thanks so much for the kind offer to meet Theo! This weekend is a no-go with everything going on, but we'd love to see you later this fall. I'll send some dates your way soon."

A few tips:
- Keep "later in the fall" loose until you actually have dates, so you aren't boxed in.
- If you'd like a softer touch, add a line like "We'll send photos in the meantime!"
- Fill in [name] or address the whole group if it's a group text.

Want me to adjust the tone, make it funnier, or write a version for a group chat?
the first one is great, can you do it in a group-chat version? thanks

Sure, here's a group-chat version:

"Hi everyone! Thank you so much for wanting to come meet Theo, it really means a lot. This weekend won't work for us. Hana has a lot going on right now, and the evenings are rough with Theo's fussy stretch, so it wouldn't be much fun for anyone. We'd love to host you later in the fall once things calm down. I'll follow up with some dates. Thanks for understanding, and we'll send a photo or two in the meantime! 🙂"

If you want to swap in names or add a sign-off, just let me know.
